name: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 (EOX), Komering basin
zoom_note: z6-13 cover the whole bounds; z14 covers only the fine box [104.20,-4.50,104.55,-4.10] plus a 4 km band along Sungai Komering from Muaradua to 3.50 S. Use overzoom of z13 elsewhere.

pixel_size_note: imagery is 10 m per pixel; z14 (~9.5 m/px at 4.3 S) is the native level
